bagPolicy.summary: All bags are searched when you enter.
bagPolicy.quote: All bags will be subject to search upon entry.

parking.summary: Parking is free in the lot behind the building and the lot across Hickory Street. During Cardinals games the Hickory Street lot is no longer free, but the lot behind the building stays free.
parking.quote: We have FREE parking in the lot behind our building & the lot across Hickory Street

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Old Rock House. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: No outside drinks are allowed in the building. Credit cards are accepted, but cash is easier and faster.
concessions.quote: No outside drinks allowed in the building (it's the law!)

accessibility.summary: To arrange accommodations, call the office at 314-588-0505, Monday through Friday from noon to 6pm, or email info@oldrockhouse.com.
accessibility.quote: Contact us in the office Monday through Friday Noon – 6:00pm at 314-588-0505

reEntry.summary: You can step outside, but guests under 21 can't come back in.
reEntry.quote: if you are under 21 you cannot come back in!

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets through the Old Rock House website, which links to Etix, and avoid third-party resellers. The box office is open for fee-free ticket sales on concert nights, though it can't sell tickets for shows by outside promoters. Children 3 and under don't need a ticket; ages 4 and up do.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office will be open for fee-free ticket sales on any night we have a concert.

gates.summary: Most shows have doors at 7pm and start at 8pm, but check each show's listing for changes.
gates.quote: Most of our shows are Doors @ 7:00pm / Show @ 8:00pm, but please check each show for changes.
